## What this changes

Describe the change and why it is needed. Link the issue it closes, for example `Closes #12`.

## How it was tested

Commands you ran, services you ran them against, and anything that still needs a real
environment to confirm. Say so plainly if a path could not be tested.

## Checklist

- [ ] `make lint` passes
- [ ] `make test` passes, and `make race` if the engine or the store changed
- [ ] No comments were added to any file
- [ ] Everything is in English
- [ ] Documentation under `docs/` is updated for any user visible change
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry for anything a user would notice
- [ ] Commit messages follow the conventional commit style in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Screenshots are attached if the panel changed
- [ ] No breaking change to the API, the configuration or the database schema, or it is described here
